summary: Session of loading a party preset (PartyPreset.lsf), created by bg3.exe+0x2DBC980 (called from the per-frame update of esv::party_preset::System); read by esv::recruit::RecruitmentSystem and esv::script::GlobalFlagsLoadSystem::LoadStoryFlagsFile (macOS WorldViews).

fields.name: PresetName
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2DC1470 initialises an ls::STDString at +0 (size +0x10 = 0, capacity +0x14 = 0xF, first byte 0); destructor bg3.exe+0x22B7260 frees it when capacity > 0xF. bg3.exe+0x2DBC980 assigns it (FUN_1441214d0) the part of the preset path between the last '/' and '.' (FUN_144120ce0 with 0x2F and 0x2E), or a whole string.

fields.name: field_18
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes a HashSet at +0x18..+0x48; destructor calls FUN_140582ad0 (POD HashSet destructor) on +0x18. bg3.exe+0x2DBC980 inserts 8-byte values with FUN_140721030 (local_590 + 3). Key assumed EntityHandle (8 bytes; not proven). Second pass: bg3.exe+0x2DBC980 line 985 inserts with FUN_140721030(comp + 0x18, ...) (HashSet insert, 8-byte keys compared as one value).

fields.name: field_48
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes a HashSet at +0x48..+0x78; destructor FUN_140582ad0(+0x48). bg3.exe+0x2DBC980 inserts every 8-byte element of a local array (FUN_140721030(comp + 0x48, ...)). Key assumed EntityHandle. Second pass: bg3.exe+0x2DBC980 lines 450-453 insert only values that pass the entity-handle validity test (>>0x36 < 0x41 and != 0xFFC0000000000000) - entity handles.

fields.name: field_78
fields.evidence: Creator writes the null handle 0xFFC0000000000000; bg3.exe+0x2DBC980 stores the preset entry's handle (+0x38 of the preset record) when it is valid, later read back and checked with IsWorldPositionOnGrid.

fields.name: field_80
fields.evidence: Creator writes 0xFFFFFFFF; destructor DecRefs it as a FixedString; bg3.exe+0x2DBC980 sets it (with IncRef) from the preset when still empty.

fields.name: field_84
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2DBC980: byte store from preset record byte +0x41 (creator zeroes +0x84..+0x87 with one 4-byte store).

fields.name: field_85
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2DBC980: byte store from preset record byte +0x40; later tested == 0 before using field_78.

fields.name: field_86
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2DBC980: byte store from preset record byte +0x42 (the same byte selects how PresetName is built).

open_questions: Meaning of the two entity sets, the handle at +0x78, the FixedString at +0x80 and the three flag bytes +0x84..+0x86 (copied from preset record bytes +0x41, +0x40, +0x42).
